messages.text: Can I run Harlo OS on a GekkoScience KBOX?
I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Let me check the current Harlo OS compatibility list before I answer.
Searched the web · Harlo OS supported devices GekkoScience KBOX
Handed to the team · Need JD to confirm KBOX support status / roadmap on the current Harlo OS model l

Hi, I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Short answer: the KBOX is not a Harlo OS flash target today.

Why:

1. Harlo OS is flashed over USB from the browser onto ESP32 based boards (Bitaxe, NerdQaxe, Hammer, Bitfortun and friends). 
You open the flasher, pick your model, connect the miner with a USB data cable, erase and install.

2. The K. is a different architecture: 
it is an enclosed unit with an integrated Mean Well supply, Ethernet plus dual band WiFi and its own Linux controller with a web dashboard.
 That controller is where its presets, tuning and RGB live, so there is nothing for the ESP32 flasher to write to.
3. You do not lose anything by it. The stock KBOX web UI already gives you pool setup, the High / Medium / Low presets and tuning. One thing worth knowing on that unit: 
High is the most efficient mode and Low costs the most energy per terahash, the reverse of most miners, so if your room can take the heat, run it on High.


The live supported model list sits on harlolabs.com (currently 17 models and JD adds more most weeks), and I could not open that page from this session, so I have asked JD, our hardware lead, to confirm whether the KBOX is on the roadmap. He will come back in this chat or by email.

Faster route if you want it straight from him: the Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , mention @nullhashrate.

Anything else on the KBOX setup I can walk you through before it arrives?
It's not listed on your website but I got an email from you about it after in relation to the KBOX order

Good catch, and that detail helps.

Two different things share the name here:

1. Harlo OS, the firmware you flash onto an ESP32 based miner over USB. That is the 17 model list on harlolabs.com.
2. Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA, which is the line sitting on your order next to the KBOX. That one is a service: our diagnostics and support cover on the unit for three months. It is not a firmware image for the KBOX.

So an email naming Harlo OS alongside your KBOX order is most likely about that service line, not about reflashing the machine.

If the email really does say the KBOX runs the firmware, I want JD to see the exact wording rather than me guessing. Can you paste the one or two lines from it that mention Harlo OS, or send a screenshot here? JD is already looped in on your question and that would settle it in one go.

Faster route to him directly: the Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , mention @nullhashrate.

Here is part of the email: Hey Vitor,
You bought a GekkoScience KBOX from us, so I wanted to make sure you knew about this.
Harlo OS
Free firmware we build with Harlo Labs. It replaces whatever your miner shipped with, and it stays free.

Thanks, that is exactly what I needed to see.

Reading it as written: it tells you Harlo OS exists and is free, it does not say the KBOX is one of the models it flashes onto. That kind of note goes out to miner owners generally, and the authoritative answer is always the model list in the flasher itself.

What I can tell you from the hardware side stays the same: the KBOX runs its own Linux controller with a web dashboard, not the ESP32 board that the browser flasher writes to, so it is not a drop in the way a Bitaxe or a Hammer is.

Where that leaves you:

1. JD has the question already, including that the email landed on a KBOX order. He is the one who decides what the list says, so his answer is the real one.
2. If the KBOX is on his roadmap, Harlo OS is free and stays free, so nothing you bought is affected either way.
3. Your KBOX ships with the GekkoScience controller ready to run: network, pool, the High / Medium / Low presets and the RGB modes are all in its own web UI, and I can walk you through pool setup the day it lands.

You will hear back from JD here or by email, usually within one business day. If you want it tonight, he is active in the Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , mention @nullhashrate and paste that same email snippet.

You're welcome, Vitor. JD will come back to you on the KBOX and Harlo OS.

When the unit arrives, ping me here if you want a hand with the pool setup or picking a power preset. Happy mining.
